answer: Sybil resistance starts with basalt-solid stake: every agent identity must lock a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, so creating thousands of fake agents costs real capital. Reputation then accrues slowly, like jade forming under pressure, and cannot be bought or transferred, so a fresh identity has no trust to spend. When a gale of fake accounts floods the network, honest agents simply raise the stake threshold, pricing the attacker out while legitimate agents keep working.
